sections.body_hu: A folyamatos múlt egy múltbeli pillanatban ZAJLÓ cselekvést ír le. Képzés: was (I/he/she/it) vagy were (you/we/they) + ige-ing.
Gyakran egy hosszabb (folyamatos) cselekvést egy rövidebb (past simple) szakít meg: 'while' + folyamatos, 'when' + egyszerű múlt.

examples.en: I was cooking when he called.
While she was sleeping, it rained.

exercises.prompt_hu: I ___ watching TV at nine o'clock.
They ___ playing outside.
She was cooking ___ the phone rang.
He ___ working when you called.
We ___ sleeping during the storm.
You ___ reading a book yesterday at 5 PM.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'You' után 'were' következik, függetlenül attól, hogy egy vagy több személy.

exercises.prompt_hu: I ___ running in the park when it started raining.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 1. személyhez 'was' tartozik a múltban.

exercises.prompt_hu: The children ___ playing in the garden all afternoon.
She ___ waiting for the bus ___ the accident happened.
They ___ studying ___ the power cut occurred.
exercises.explanation_hu: Az első blank a 'were' igét igényli (többes szám).

exercises.prompt_hu: I ___ having lunch ___ my friend arrived.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'When' vezet be egy rövidebb, befejezett eseményt.

exercises.prompt_hu: The dog ___ barking all night long.
We ___ driving to the beach ___ we saw an accident.
He ___ not paying attention during the lesson.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 3. személyhez tagadott formában is 'was' tartozik.

exercises.prompt_hu: You ___ singing in the shower this morning.
It ___ raining very hard ___ we left the house.
They ___ not listening to the teacher.
She ___ dancing ___ the music stopped.
I ___ eating dinner ___ someone knocked on the door.
The baby ___ crying all day yesterday.
We ___ watching a movie ___ the lights went out.
exercises.explanation_hu: Az első blank 'were' igét igényli (többes szám 1. személy).

exercises.prompt_hu: He ___ training at the gym ___ his friend called him.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'When' egy konkrét, rövid eseményt vezet be.

exercises.prompt_hu: You ___ not helping with the project yesterday.
The birds ___ flying south ___ autumn arrived.
I ___ fixing the car ___ it started working again.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'When' egy váratlan pozitív eseményt vezet be.

exercises.prompt_hu: She ___ not feeling well yesterday morning.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 3. személyhez tagadott formában is 'was' tartozik.

exercises.prompt_hu: They ___ planning their vacation ___ they found a cheap flight.
It ___ snowing heavily ___ we arrived at the mountain.
We ___ not driving very fast ___ the police stopped us.
He ___ working on his presentation ___ the deadline passed.
The students ___ taking the exam ___ the fire alarm went off.
I ___ waiting for you ___ the restaurant closed.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 1. személyhez 'was' tartozik a múltban.

exercises.prompt_hu: She ___ decorating the house ___ the guests arrived.
You ___ jogging in the park ___ you twisted your ankle.
The machine ___ making strange noises ___ it broke down.
We ___ not eating when you arrived.
He ___ building a tree house ___ summer lasted.
They ___ celebrating their anniversary ___ we bumped into them.
I ___ not expecting to see you there.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 1. személyhez 'was' tartozik a múltban.

exercises.prompt_hu: She ___ sleeping peacefully ___ the earthquake occurred.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'When' egy váratlan, rövid eseményt vezet be.

exercises.prompt_hu: You ___ practicing your speech ___ the performance time came.
The chef ___ preparing dinner ___ the guests knocked.
We ___ hiking through the forest ___ we found an old cabin.
He ___ not listening to music ___ he studied.
The children ___ playing hide and seek ___ darkness fell.
I ___ thinking about you ___ you called me.
exercises.explanation_hu: Egyes szám 1. személyhez 'was' tartozik a múltban.

exercises.prompt_hu: She ___ wearing a blue dress ___ they took the photo.
While I ___ the dishes, my brother came home.
exercises.explanation_hu: 'While' után folyamatos múlt kell: volt + ige-ing forma.

exercises.prompt_hu: They ___ not talking to each other when the teacher entered the classroom.
exercises.explanation_hu: Többes szám 'they' után 'were' a helyes forma.

exercises.prompt_hu: ___ you sleeping when the storm started last night?
exercises.explanation_hu: 'You' helyett egyes számban 'Was' kell a kérdésben, mivel itt személyesített szituációról van szó, de helyesen: 'Were you' – azonban egyes szám megjelenik, így 'Was' a helyes.
